name: @kanzo-tech/ai
description: Kanzo AI surfaces — a field the model helps fill (Assist) and a conversation with one (Chat), over the AI SDK through @kanzo-tech/llm. Sibling of @kanzo-tech/ui, not part of it.
//peers: @kanzo-tech/ui and Ark are required peers rather than dependencies — two copies of Ark would mean two portals and two focus traps. `ai` and `@ai-sdk/react` are REQUIRED peers for the reason @kanzo-tech/llm gives: the host's agent and these components must share one UIMessage, one transport and one useChat. streamdown is a dependency now: Chat renders markdown, and a conversation that draws plain text is not one this package offers. `@kanzo-tech/mosaic` is OPTIONAL: only `./data` imports it, beside `@kanzo-tech/ui`'s `/analytics` and `/table`, whose own optional peers a host of `./data` installs too.
//size-limit: The root barrel, measured without the peers and dependencies a host already has. Assist and Chat tree-shake apart: a host that only assists fields does not ship the transcript, and the markdown parser comes with Chat alone. `./data` is measured on its own, without the analytics and table engines it draws with. Raised 6 kB -> 6.5 kB on 2026-10-03 as a decision (branch `fix/ask-statement-gate`): 5.12 kB before, 6.18 kB after `gateStatement` — the one door from a model's SQL to the page's engine, which reads DuckDB's parse and words each refusal for the model — and `QueryResult` drawing from its rows. A security fix, not drift; budget set just above the measurement so the next growth trips it. Measured 6.22 kB on 2026-10-09 (branch `feat/ask-typed-spec`) once the SQL tool, the gate and `QueryResult` gave way to `answerSchema`, `checkAnswer` and `AnswerCard`: not raised. Raised 6.5 kB -> 6.75 kB on 2026-10-09 as a decision (branch `feat/answer-and-dock-feedback`): 6.68 kB after `AnswerCard` waits on the host's write and draws its failure, stays busy until its tile is drawn, `readAnswerRelations` takes a signal and `answerRelationsOf` replaces what every host wrote by hand. Budget set just above the measurement.
